analyticsDescription: Share which features are used and app errors to help improve Salaty Time. Your location and what you listen to are never sent.
weekStartFixedDesc: The first column of the Hijri calendar
hijriAdjustmentDesc: Leave at 0. Change it only if the date below is a day off from your country’s official date. Example: the app shows 1 Ramadan, but your country starts Ramadan tomorrow → choose −1.
calcMethodAutoHint: The authority closest to your location
calcMethodFixedDesc: Used instead of your location's method
calcAsrDesc: Hanafi: Asr starts later (about 30–60 min). Only Asr changes.
stViewDesc: Menu: one category at a time. One page: everything in one list.
showTimesDesc: Extra times on the home page and the widget. The five prayers are always shown. Midnight is the middle of the night, when Isha time ends.
timeFormatDesc: How prayer times are written in the app and the widget.
adhanVoiceDesc: Played at each prayer time. Press ▶ to listen.
adhanCreditsText: Recordings from Wikimedia Commons, each under its own licence (ⓘ on its tile).
adhanFajrDesc: Fajr can have its own voice.
adhanCustomTooBig: This file is too big (30 MB at most).
adhanCustomType: Choose an audio file (MP3, M4A, OGG, WAV…).
adhanCustomError: The file could not be copied. Try again.
adhanCustomBroken: This audio file cannot be played.
